text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is filled with a strange,
buzzing
energy, and the reason is
simple. Apart from
Зенно Роб Рой and
Спешл Уик...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Эйр Грув and Фудзи Кисэки are also
joining the
fray. All have made a name
for themselves in the
G1. The
excitement is palpable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In contrast to her rivals, Эйсин Флэш's
fire burns
quietly—after all, the more
challenging the race,
the more
worthwhile it is to compete in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
